proposal.summary: An information disclosure in GitLab EE allowed other Group Owners to read the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination; fixed so Owners can only write the key, not read it. Affected versions: 16.2 before 16.2.5 and 16.3 before 16.3.1.
proposal.cwe_quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify which groups had the Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination configured, rotate any exposed public keys if required, and backport the fix to affected instances; update access-control tests to prevent owner-read where only write is permitted.
